potential_clients.summary: Elgin Dental Implants is a practice less than a year old that has been working with seven different marketing firms and currently uses four vendors with fragmented results showing only 2-3x ROI. Flow Company initially proposed consolidating to a single unified marketing solution with HIPAA-compliant EMR integration to replace their scattered tracking systems. In the follow-up meeting, the discussion advanced to specific pricing at $3,500 per month plus $2,000 ad spend, covering Open Dental integration for real-time lead tracking, strategies to grow from 148 reviews to 30-50 monthly reviews, adding Spanish SEO for their bilingual patient base, expanding beyond Meta Ads to Google Local Service Ads for surgical implant cases, and implementing AI-powered missed call follow-ups. The practice is considering a minimum three-month contract with a decision expected mid-November.
action_items: Sohib to provide tailored overview presentation addressing how Flow Company's consolidated approach can improve integration and ROI.
Sohib to provide detailed information on Google Local Service Ads for review and consideration.

meetings_digest.title: Maadi Law GHL Onboarding
key_points: Unified Communication: All client calls, texts, forms, and Instagram DMs routed to one GHL inbox with automated replies and timely human follow-up.
Pipeline Management: Leads tracked through stages triggering workflows; manual card moves update lead status and automations.
Automated Document Workflow: Moving leads triggers sending HIPAA and agreement templates; templates support minors and multi-signers, with Dropbox storage.
Lead Data Capture: Forms auto-populate contact fields; manual entry needed for organic calls; tagging supports filtering and reporting.
Phased Launch: Go-live planned by September 1st with gradual automation activation and weekly check-ins to fix issues.

key_points: Platform Integration: Peer Dent handles practice tasks; GoHighLevel manages marketing leads and communication separately to improve lead quality and workflow clarity.
Lead & Appointment Sync: API sync reflects scheduling and lead status in both systems; missed calls trigger automated texts to reduce lead loss.
Marketing Model: Full-service agency with specialists creates targeted ads, monthly video content, and uses automation to nurture high-quality dental patient leads.
Pricing Structure: Flat retainer starts at $3,500/location plus $1,500-$2,000 ad spend; packages include content, ads, automation, reporting, and dedicated support.
Operational Challenges: Staff juggle Peer Dent and GoHighLevel, raising concerns over extra logins; no after-hours support causes missed patient leads.
